name: U-Konserve Stainless Container
description: U-Konserve 50 oz stainless steel container with a silicone lid. The brand states 18/8 steel and a platinum silicone lid, and states the products are tested for BPA, BPS, and phthalates. The page checked does not say PFAS-free.
features: U-Konserve's product-information page says the containers are 18/8 stainless steel and the lids are platinum-grade, food-grade silicone.

That page says the products are tested by CPSIA-accredited independent labs for BPA, BPS, and phthalates, and that the silicone is without fillers and meets FDA and European LFGB standards. It does not use the word PFAS.

The brand says the containers are oven safe up to 300°F, that they can be used hotter or under the broiler without the silicone cover, that above 450°F the steel may discolor, and not to use them above 600°F.
Amazon ASIN B09TRYSHZ4 is the 50 oz blue container. The listing says it is not microwaveable.
labelNote: The brand's lab sentence names BPA, BPS, and phthalates. It does not name PFAS. The silicone lid is the part to take off before high heat.
